response.sql: WITH rating_stats AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_per_day_rate FROM film GROUP BY rating), rating_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_per_day_rate) AS mean_per_day_rate FROM rating_stats) SELECT AVG(rs.avg_length) AS avg_length, AVG(rs.avg_per_day_rate) AS avg_per_day_rate, AVG(rs.avg_per_day_rate - rm.mean_per_day_rate) AS avg_excess_per_day FROM rating_stats AS rs CROSS JOIN rating_mean AS rm WHERE rs.avg_per_day_rate > rm.mean_per_day_rate;

assumptions.assumption: Each film’s per-day rate is its rental_rate divided by rental_duration; averages within and across ratings are unweighted.
